visual_review.method: problem-statement pages (TS pp. 4-5, 7-8, 12-13, 19-21, 25, 28-30, 35-36, 39-41, 46-50, 59-62) reuse the published Korean problem paper 2022.html block for block (identical source geometry verified), with header/footer stamps regenerated for the TS page parity; every solution page was compared side by side with the source at 75 dpi with 150-300 dpi close-ups of footers and stamp edges; first-line baselines of all solution-page blocks measured against the source (all within 1 pt; 45 continuation lines of reflowed paragraphs differ by 1-3.5 pt where the source line was opened by tall inline math); no backslash or U+FFFD in the PDF text; check.py leaves 26 explained items: intended 'ov' Korean point labels over stamps (pp. 33, 37, 38), KaTeX box extents (off-page p6, p9, p40, p49, p50; p17 and p33 box overlaps with no ink overlap); page size is Chrome's A4 (594.96x841.92 vs 595.28x841.89 pt) as in all ko_reflow builds; edgecheck.py: 7 stamp crops that cut ink (p14, p16, p17, p29, p39, p49, p66) moved to the blank rows next to the display and checked visually, 0 remaining
